Spavia Day Spa is the resort-inspired day spa franchise delivering affordable luxury wellness — personalized facials, massage therapy, and body treatments — across 60+ locations in 25 states.

On this channel, you'll find expert skincare education from our Director of Spa Services in our Face the Facts series, real stories from Spavia franchise owners building thriving wellness businesses in their communities, behind-the-scenes looks at what it's like to work at Spavia, and guest experiences that show why our locations average 4.8 stars across 30,000+ reviews.
Whether you're looking for skincare tips, exploring a career in wellness, or considering spa franchise ownership, subscribe for new videos every week.

Book a treatment: https://spaviadayspa.com
Explore franchise ownership: https://spaviafranchise.com

Follow us: instagram.com/spaviadayspa | facebook.com/SpaviaDaySpa | linkedin.com/company/spavia
